preprocessing: in-fold top-2000 variance genes, StandardScaler; reduced view PCA-8
quantum_view: PCA-8 rescaled to [0, pi] on the training fold
vqc: 5 one-vs-rest binary VQCs (angle encoding, 2 StronglyEntanglingLayers, class-weighted BCE, Adam lr 0.05, batch 32, 30 epochs), scores normalised to sum to 1, argmax
qsvm: IQPEmbedding (2 repeats) exact fidelity kernel, multi-class SVC C=1, softmax of OvR decision values

environment.quantum_device: default.qubit (noiseless statevector simulator, analytic expectation values)
